svg.title: Asimov v1 assurance: An open humanoid. Engineered for safety.
svg.desc: Asimov v1 assurance banner: upstream's photograph of the robot, a dark humanoid with a camera in its chest against an orange background, on the right of a dark panel that carries the project name and the tagline An open humanoid. Engineered for safety. Chips name the standards: ISO 12100, ISO 10218, ISO 13482, ISO 13849-1, IEC 62443, Machinery Reg. (EU) 2023/1230.
